title: Browser Capture To PDF
summary: Reusable browser-side capture tool that exports clicked elements, dragged regions, or the full page to a PDF.

captureTargetSelectors.description: Semantic selectors that should be preferred when the operator clicks a target to capture.

onStatusChange.description: Host callback for human-facing status text. Useful when the host app wants to print or surface timestamped status messages.

host_requirements: Ability to render a floating button and overlay
host_responsibilities: Import the variant CSS or restyle the exported components
Mount the camera button in a reachable part of the app shell
Render the overlay while capture mode is active

manual_checks: Double click exports full page PDF
Ctrl+Shift+P while active exports full page PDF
Drag selection exports only selected rectangle
HUD helper does not appear inside exported PDF
automation_targets: Playwright can trigger the shortcut and assert download output
Playwright can drag a region and verify capture file creation
Component tests can verify overlay visibility and status transitions

compatibility_notes: Works best in React, Vue, and Nuxt apps with direct DOM rendering.
Complex canvases, videos, and cross-origin iframes may not render fully under html2canvas limitations.
Large pages can create multi-page PDFs depending on rendered image height.

upgrade_strategy.policy: Keep variant behavior aligned. Translate the React source forward first, then update Nuxt/Vue immediately after.
upgrade_strategy.drift_rule: Do not ship a behavior change in one variant without recording the translation delta in translation-map.md.
upgrade_strategy.placement_note: Future Active Cloner placement should prefer the variant matching the host app framework and emit a translation trace in placement metadata.
